notes.title: Controller support and languages update
notes.content:
- Added controller support
- Added Traditional Chinese localization

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
- Missing symbols in different languages have been corrected
- An error that caused the skip button to appear inactive after choosing an option in the dialogue has been resolved
- The day indicator will now remain on the screen for an extended period
- A few errors in the credits have been corrected

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
- Fixed bug where background was missing after CG under certain conditions
- Fixed problem where MC name was not displayed in some lines
- Fixed Log button position for different resolutions
- Clicking on the dialogue box now shows the next line of text
- Dynamic change of music as settings are changed
- UI sounds are now controlled by the sound setting
- Auditorium background updated
- Alternative version of one of Emy's CGs added
